candidates.name: liver metastasis
support_spans: Thirteen months after surgery, follow-up CT revealed a 25 mm lesion in segment 8 of the liver.
CTA demonstrated a liver tumor with two components: a solid portion that enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase, and a cystic component.
candidates.why: The patient has a history of colon cancer and the liver lesion is consistent with metastasis.

candidates.name: hepatocellular carcinoma
support_spans: CTA demonstrated a liver tumor with two components: a solid portion that enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase, and a cystic component.
PIVKA-II were all within normal limits
contradict_spans: hepatitis B and C serologies were negative
candidates.why: The patient has a liver tumor with characteristics suggestive of hepatocellular carcinoma, but the absence of hepatitis B and C serologies and normal PIVKA-II levels make it less likely.

candidates.name: colon cancer metastasis to the liver with portal vein tumor thrombus

candidates.why: The patient has a history of colon cancer and the liver lesion with portal vein tumor thrombus is consistent with metastasis.
